summary: This is an 8-K filed by Brightwood Capital Corp I, a business development company, solely to report the declaration of a $0.31 per share distribution to shareholders. The distribution is payable on June 18, 2026, with a record date of June 4, 2026. No special situation transaction—such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review—is disclosed. The filing is a routine dividend announcement, which does not fall under any of the defined special-situations categories.
